newsitem.title: CHINA: Shanghai B shares down at noon on Jinan Qingqi.
newsitem.headline: Shanghai B shares down at noon on Jinan Qingqi.

text.p: Shanghai B shares were down at midday on Tuesday with most investors offsetting their positions in other shares to trade the newly-listed Jinan Qingqi Motorcycle Co, brokers said.
The B index fell 0.783 points or 0.92 percent to 84.436 on volume of 29.724 million shares worth $17.81 million.
Jinan Qingqi's 230 million B shares were listed today and ended the morning session at $0.592, compared with an issue price of $0.482.
Shares are not included in the index calculations on the first day of issue.

"The newcomer Jinan Qingqi attracted huge capital, resulting in sluggish trading in other shares," one broker said. "But the performance of Qinan Qingqi is not as good as most investors expected, indicating market sentiment is weaker."
"The newcomer failed to boost market sentiment, so the market will test new lows in the short term," another broker said. "But it may see support at 80 points."
Of 44 B shares, 38 traded, with 23 down, five flat and 10 up.
Shanghai Yaohua Pilkington Glass was the biggest loser on position-adjusting selling, plunging $0.040 or 9.09 percent to $0.400 on volume of 121,700 shares.

Shanghai Lujiazui Finance and Trade Zone Development was the second most actively traded following Jinan Qingqi, shedding $0.010 or 0.68 percent to $1.448 on a technical correction on volume of 480,000 shares.

Shanghai's A share index was down after gains over the past two trading days, with investors concerned over the issue of detailed measures banning state firms from speculating in stocks, brokers said.
The state firms had been asked to bring their trading into line with the new requirements by June 22, brokers said.
The index slipped 13.034 points or 0.99 percent to 1,304.098 points on volume of 145.4 million shares worth 2.0 billion yuan.
The SSE30 blue chip index shed 21.507 points or 0.55 percent to 3,858.276 points.
Xinjiang Hops was the biggest loser on profit-taking, slumping 0.80 yuan or 6.89 percent to 10.80 yuan on volume of 2.1 million shares.
